description: Videos reserved for evaluation or calibration. No training split, expansion run, or checkpoint may use them for weight training. The calibration videos may serve only as model-selection validation, as they already did for the AVA80 v5 checkpoint.

ava_holdout_v1_test.purpose: held-out test of the 2026-10-25 benchmark; its parser failures were inspected, so it is no longer untouched for parser evaluation

ava_holdout_v2_test.purpose: untouched held-out test for the final comparison; queries use pre-registered PHRASES_V2
ava_holdout_v2_test.selection_rule: official AVA v2.2 val videos not in any split, expansion-completed set, existing benchmark, or local media; ordered by sha256(video_id); first three
